I paid Delta Printworks's approved invoice once, in full, by wire from the operating account.

- **Invoice:** INV-99625, due 2026-11-04
- **Amount:** $7,401.36
- **Payment ID:** PAY0002, status: sent and verified

Before sending, I checked the payment history and found no earlier payments, so this isn't a duplicate. I also attached a one-time key (pay-INV-99625) so a retry can't send it twice. The amount is under $10,000, so it didn't need the controller's approval.

I left Delta Printworks's other two invoices alone. INV-86330 was already marked paid, and INV-99666 is still a draft waiting for approval.
